I answered Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 382 seats. That's the number Tobias posted in the same channel on Oct 14. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the team.

I couldn't check it against anything else. There are no Marrow Agrisupply files in the share, so Tobias's message is the only source.
